management.mid-plane-bus: RS-485, polled by the power-supply controller; SNMP through a CX3002 / CX3003C / CX3033N

physical.weight-note: CH3000C, with top and bottom covers; the CH3000N without covers is 4.5 kg

power.power-bus: 12 VDC mid-plane bus, fed by the PS3006 / PS3248 controller-supply

configs.description: Fourteen AR3002E forward receivers in slots 3-16, each on its own BP-A5 back plate, beside the one PS3006D - the "up to 14 receivers in one 3RU chassis" of the AR3002E data sheet. Illustrative: modules and back plates are ordered separately.
configs.name: ar3002e-x14

configs.description: One PS3006D power supply and controller in slots 1-2 with its BP-P1 back plate, and every other slot empty - the chassis powered and manageable before any optics are chosen. Empty slots are drawn open: the one front blank named in any document held, the BP3000, is neither drawn nor photographed (see gaps).
configs.name: base

configs.description: The -48 VDC build: a PS3248D power supply and controller in slots 1-2 on the BP-P2 back plate it ships with, and a CX3003C enhanced communications module fitted in the top of that back plate for SNMP management - the CX data sheets' "no additional chassis slot required". Every other slot is empty.
configs.name: dc-power

configs.description: Four DR3450N quad digital return receivers in slots 3-6 sharing one BP3400C-00 back plate behind them - the data sheet's "four DR3450N modules per BP3400C back plate", sixteen digital return receivers - beside the one PS3006D. The plate's SFP receivers are ordered separately and are not seated. The other slots are empty.
configs.name: digital-return

configs.description: Fourteen FA3521S-01 21 dBm EDFAs in slots 3-16, each on the BP-F2 back plate it ships with, beside the one PS3006D - 182 W of amplifiers at 13 W each, inside the supply's 300 W. Illustrative: the FA3500 data sheet states the modules, not a build.
configs.name: edfa-x14

configs.description: Half-depth modules front and rear in every slot from 3 to 16 - the chassis data sheet's "32 half-depth slots (16 front-loaded and 16 rear-loaded)" - beside the one PS3006D. Slots 3-6: the switches and the NP35 DWDM family (NP35M08 over NP35D08, OS32M2B with AB32S1G, NP35M04 over NP35D04, NP35F01 with NP35F04S). Slots 7-11: the NP34/OP34 CWDM filters and multiplexers (NP34M08 with NP34B10S, OP34M8C over OP34M10C, NP34M05 over OP34D5x, OP34M5x with NP34C01, NP34F01D with OP34F1D). Slots 12-16: NP33F01 with OP35D8-CF, the NP34S04 / OP34S4S splitters, NP35C0x with OP31M2D, OP35F1 with OP35F1D, and OP35F4S with OP35D4x. Part and channel numbers are the photographs'. Illustrative.
configs.name: half-depth-mix

configs.description: The HT3580H data sheet's own p1 photograph: the "48 transmitters per 3RU chassis, with redundant power supplies" build. A PS3006D in slots 1-2, six CA3008 carriers in slots 3-14, each holding a CC3008 and eight HT3584H transmitters, and a PS3006N in slots 15-16; behind each carrier a BD31A8-100-H10F back plate. Every carrier in the photograph prints channels 20 to 27 from the top, and the transmitters here carry the same. Illustrative: carriers, transmitters and back plates are ordered separately.
configs.name: ht3584h-x48

configs.description: A second supply for redundancy - the PS3006 data sheet "Supports redundant power supplies" - placed as the HT3580H sheet's chassis photograph places it: a PS3006N in slots 15-16, with a BP-P1 behind it. The PS3006N's B/U PS lamp is what reports it.
configs.name: redundant-power

configs.description: Fourteen AR3044H quad high-gain return receivers in slots 3-16, each on the BP-A10 back plate it ships with, beside the one PS3006D: fifty-six return-path receivers in the chassis. Illustrative - the AR3044H data sheet states the module, not a build.
configs.name: return-x14

gaps.note: a front blank is named once: the FA3500 data sheet's ordering note ships "a BP3000 blank face plate" with the FA3524S, for the front of the slot its double-wide back plate leaves empty. No document draws or photographs a BP3000, and no rear blank is named in any of the 164 data sheets held; a rear plate legended BP3001 appears beside a BP-P2 in the CX3003C sheet's photograph and is probably the rear blank, but no document names or describes it.
gaps.wanted: a photograph or drawing of the BP3000 front blank, and the part number of the rear blank

gaps.note: the PS3006D and PS3006N on the HT3580H chassis photograph carry an older face - a 3.5 mm jack legended Serial in place of the micro-USB, and vertical vent slots on the PS3006N - than the PS3006 data sheet's own photographs. The current face is modelled.
gaps.wanted: the revision history of the PS3006 faceplate

gaps.note: the HT3580H data sheet names three back plates for a CA3008 carrier and photographs one, the BD31A8-100-H10F modelled here. The BD31A8-100-H18F (eight BC inputs, no NC) and the BD35M8 mux plates (-ACx and -EEx with three SC/APC, -DCx with six LC/APC, each with nine F-type inputs) are described in text only, so their layouts are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a face-on photograph or drawing of a BD31A8-100-H18F and of a BD35M8

gaps.note: the FA3524S ships with a double-wide BP-F3 back plate (three SC/APC ports for its input and two outputs) that leaves the neighbouring slot empty for cooling, per the FA3500 data sheet's ordering note 2. The BP-F2, BP-F2-AL and BP-F4 are drawn in that sheet; the BP-F3 is not, so an FA3524S can be seated but its back plate is not modelled.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or photograph of the BP-F3

gaps.note: the chassis data sheets state the arrangement - "32 half-depth slots (16 front-loaded and 16 rear-loaded)" and "32 midplane electrical interconnects (16 front and 16 rear)", and the OR3144H sheet says a half-depth module can be plugged in from either side - so a half-depth module seats in a slot's front bay or in its rear bay, where a full-depth module's back plate would go, and that is how the half-depth modules modelled here seat. No photograph held shows one installed, front or rear, to confirm its face against the slot. Not modelled: the DT3550N transmitter, whose data sheet has no face image; the 8- and 10-channel CWDM demultiplexers (NP34D08, NP34D10, OP34D8C, OP34D10C), whose data-sheet photographs are the multiplexer's artwork relabelled - they print "CWDM MUX" where the photographed 5-channel demux prints "CWDM DEMUX", and the OP34D10C sheet's image is labelled OP34M10C; the OP3168P and OP3178P octal PON filters, whose faces are a dense grid of LC adapters with legends the data-sheet photographs do not resolve; the NP31F08S06 RFoG filter, which has no face image; and the 8x8 splitters (NP38S08, OP38S8S), which are two slots wide and only drawn.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of a CH3000 with half-depth modules seated, front and rear

gaps.note: several half-depth families are modelled as the one variant their data sheet photographs, and the others would present a different port set: OP33F1x as the single OP33F1S (the dual OP33F1D has six ports); NP35C0x as the NP35C01D03 red/blue split (the family also takes CWDM/DWDM and DWDM-group splits, single or dual, with an optional test port, each legended differently); and OP35F4S as the variant with a -20 dB test port (the test port is optional). Each would need its own photograph.
gaps.wanted: face photographs of the OP33F1D, the other NP35C0x variants and an OP35F4S without a test port

`physical-context` on 45 bays (front 22, rear 23) - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

back-plates.note: every active module mates a dynamic back plate seated in the rear of its slot(s); the chassis data sheet says the dynamic back plates let a module be replaced from the front without touching the cabling at the back. So the rear view's bays hold back plates, one per module, spanning the same columns.

chassis-variants.note: sold as CH3000C (top and bottom covers, 7 kg) and CH3000N (no covers, 4.5 kg). The views model the CH3000C's covered box, which is what the HT3580H photograph shows; the N's open frame, photographed on the Aurora 2004 sheet, is not drawn yet.

depth.note: CH3000 Chassis data sheet, Dimensions: 13.3 in D (34 cm)

height.note: CH3000 Chassis data sheet, Dimensions: 5.22 in H (13.5 cm), 3RU

slot-height.note: module faceplates run y 142-497 of the 1344 px chassis photograph, 355 px = 130.2 mm of the 132.6 mm face, leaving the frame rail visible above; drawn centred at y 1.2.

slot-numbering.note: FRONT 1-16 LEFT TO RIGHT; REAR 16-1 LEFT TO RIGHT as seen from behind, so front N and rear N are one mid-plane column. The chassis data sheet says only "All slots are identical (no specific slot allocation)", but the controller's display numbers them: on the HT3580H photograph the PS3006D in the two left-hand slots reads "Slot 2", and on the Aurora 2004 sheet's front photograph a PS3001D counted into slots 10-11 reads "Slot 11". So the vendor counts from the left, and A TWO-SLOT MODULE IS ADDRESSED BY ITS RIGHT-HAND SLOT - a two-slot bay is named for both slots (slot-1-2) and takes the higher number as its rel-pos.

slot-opening.note: AN EMPTY SLOT IS OPEN FROM ITS NEIGHBOUR'S EDGE TO ITS OWN, so each bay's opening is the full 26.76 pitch (53.52 for a two-slot bay) while its size is the faceplate's 25.76. The 1.0 mm between faceplates is clearance between modules, not metal: the Aurora 2004 sheet's empty-chassis photograph shows one open span between the top and bottom rails with no divider between slots, and both faces are declared open-frame.

slot-pitch.note: 26.76 mm. Each slot carries one captive thumbscrew on its centre line at the top of the module face; on the HT3580H chassis photograph the sixteen screws fit a straight line of 72.97 px pitch with a largest residual of 1.65 px (0.6 mm). The Aurora empty chassis gives 26.75 from its rail holes against the 433 body. A faceplate is one pitch less a 1.0 mm gap (25.76; a two-slot module 52.52), the gap read between the PS3006D and the first CA3008 on the same photograph.

sources.note: datasheets and photographs only - the CH3000 Chassis datasheet (2022) and its Aurora 2004 predecessor, the Chassis Accessories datasheet, the PS3006 and AR3002E datasheets, and the HT3580H datasheet whose p1 photograph is the face-on chassis front every front measurement is taken from (all in `references`). NO INSTALLATION MANUAL OR HARDWARE GUIDE IS PUBLIC: the vendor's sit behind an entitled support portal, so nothing here comes from one, and slot placement rests on photographs.

width.note: 433 mm between the side walls, from two photographs that agree. The HT3580H sheet's p1 chassis front, stitched from seven 1344 x 73 tiles, spans 1316 px between the rack ears' outer edges - the data sheet's 19.0 in (482.6 mm), which INCLUDES the ears - giving 2.727 px/mm, and the face's 360 px height against the data sheet's 5.22 in agrees to 0.4%, so the face is near-orthographic. Its sixteen slots span 428.2 mm. The Aurora 2004 sheet's empty CH3000N front puts the slot pitch at 6.178% of the outer frame; 26.76 / 0.06178 = 433.1. The ears are not drawn.
